branch.label: update branch
branch.help: Update track selected by the Pi installer: testing and main follow their branches. Other tracks, including release and beta, prefer the latest matching track-* tag, then the branch, then main if the reference is missing. This is independent of the source picker above.
branch.detailedHelp:
testing and main follow their branch directly.

release, beta and other track names first select the latest version-sorted tag matching track-*. Without a matching tag, the installer tries that branch. If the selected reference does not exist, it falls back to main.

The source picker above reads config.json from the exact branch or reference you choose; it does not resolve update-track tags.

repo.label: update repo
repo.help: GitHub repository URL used by the Pi updater. Use the full https://github.com/owner/repository URL.

config_restore_repo.help: Repository from which the installer restores a replacement config.json when you request a config reset.
config_restore_repo.label: Config restore repo

config_restore_branch.help: Branch used for a requested config reset. Normal updates preserve your existing config.
config_restore_branch.detailedHelp: Reference from which a requested config reset downloads config.json. Use the branch or tag that contains the replacement config you want. The current installer keeps your existing config during normal updates.
config_restore_branch.label: Config restore branch

display.center_display.enabled.help: Enable or disable the cluster display service.
display.center_display.enabled.label: Enabled

display.center_display.high_resolution.label: High Resolution
display.center_display.high_resolution.help: Selects existing high or normal artwork and other app/font layouts. An explicit Stock or Bitmap navigation icon choice uses the white DIS layout with the native approach bar at either artwork resolution. Keep a saved legacy font profile for a red DIS.

display.center_display.mode.label: Default App
display.center_display.mode.help: Center DIS app selected at startup. car_info uses named-value pages on the white DIS and the legacy vehicle summary on the red DIS.

display.center_display.applist.label: Configured Applications
display.center_display.applist.help: Ordered JSON list of apps available when cycling the center display. Keep the app IDs: nav, media, phone, car_info, acceleration_test; coverart can also be selected.

display.center_display.navigation.native.label: Navigation Icon Rendering
display.center_display.navigation.native.help: Planes draw the icon quickly and then refine it. Tiles finish each small area before moving on.

display.center_display.navigation.icon_s.label: Navigation Icons
display.center_display.navigation.icon_s.help: Stock uses native font icons without numeric distance. Bitmap uses the existing high or normal artwork and numeric next-maneuver distance. Both use the native approach bar and full-width street on a white DIS.

display.center_display.navigation.native.label: Icon Drawing Pause (ms)
display.center_display.navigation.native.help: Increase this pause if native icons show stray pixels.

display.center_display.navigation.auto_s.help: Temporarily show navigation when a maneuver approaches. Each new maneuver gets a five-second preview; manually choosing another page suppresses that maneuver’s automatic approach switch.
display.center_display.navigation.auto_s.label: Auto switch

display.center_display.navigation.auto_s.help: Distance to the maneuver, in meters, at which navigation takes over the center display. The example uses 500 m.
display.center_display.navigation.auto_s.label: Auto switch approach threshold

display.center_display.navigation.auto_s.help: Distance to a later maneuver, in meters, beyond which the previous app can return after the approach sequence. Keep this larger than the approach threshold to avoid switching back and forth.
display.center_display.navigation.auto_s.label: Auto switch return threshold

display.center_display.navigation.approa.help: Distance in meters used to scale the native maneuver-approach bar. This controls the bar’s visual range, independently of automatic page switching.
display.center_display.navigation.approa.label: Approach bar max distance

display.center_display.navigation.claim_.help: Auto-claim center display when a route starts and release when it ends.
display.center_display.navigation.claim_.label: Claim on nav

display.center_display.coverart.native_p.label: Native Image Preset
display.center_display.coverart.native_p.help: legacy uses existing Processing Args at native resolution; balanced uses ordered dither; photo uses error diffusion; text uses a crisp threshold.

display.center_display.coverart.native_a.label: Native Processing Overrides
display.center_display.coverart.native_a.help: JSON object of overrides for the selected native preset. Empty uses its defaults. With legacy, these override Processing Args. Dimensions stay 128x96.

display.center_display.coverart.native_r.label: Native Draw Order
display.center_display.coverart.native_r.help: tiles completes small regions before moving on. planes draws the base then subpixel layers; bands completes horizontal strips. All produce the same target pixels.

display.center_display.coverart.native_d.label: Native Changed Tiles
display.center_display.coverart.native_d.help: Send only changed tiles after an acknowledged image. Requires tiles draw order. Disabled sends a full snapshot for each cover.

display.center_display.coverart.args.label: Processing Args
display.center_display.coverart.args.help: JSON object of legacy image-processing overrides. Used by the legacy preset; the other native presets use their own defaults plus native_args. Open the help button for each processing argument.
display.center_display.coverart.args.detailedHelp:
contrast: Contrast multiplier; 1 leaves contrast unchanged.

sharpen: Sharpening multiplier; 1 leaves sharpness unchanged.

dither: Monochrome dither method, e.g. fs for Floyd–Steinberg.

invert: Invert the final monochrome pixels.

no_enhance: Skip automatic enhancement before conversion.

bg_fill: Background color used when fitting the image.

grayscale_mode: Grayscale conversion strategy; smart uses luminance processing.

brightness: Brightness multiplier; 1 leaves brightness unchanged.

gamma: Gamma applied during grayscale processing.

black_floor: Shadow cutoff (0–255) used before monochrome conversion.

boldness: Pixel expansion amount for strengthening fine features.

diffusion: Error-diffusion strength for dithered output.

display.center_display.acceleration_test.label: Auto Reset on Stop
display.center_display.acceleration_test.help: Resets acceleration timers when stopped for configured delay.

display.center_display.acceleration_test.label: Auto Reset Delay
display.center_display.acceleration_test.help: Delay in seconds before auto reset when stopped.

display.center_display.acceleration_test.label: Line 1
display.center_display.acceleration_test.detailedHelp:
Configure this line in 3 ways:

1. Speed-to-Speed: e.g. '0-60', '0-100', '60-130' (uses Configure Speed Units setting)
2. Distance Timer: e.g. '1/4' (quarter mile) or '1000' (feet). Distances below 10 assume Miles/KM based on units, above 10 assume Feet/Meters.
3. Live Speed: enter 'speed' to show current velocity

display.top_display.applist.help: Top-line app priority, highest first. The first app with active content wins: phone for a call, nav for guidance, media for playback.

display.top_display.media_line1_alt_mode.help: Displayed when center display is already showing media. Formatting: key-key-key (title, artist, album, source)

display.units.boost_mode.help: Absolute pressure or pressure minus atmosphere for the red DIS Car Info screen and older boost widget. New DIS pages select the desired value from the catalog.

display.text_scrolling.continuous_gap.label: Continuous gap

display.text_scrolling.speed_ms.help: Milliseconds between scrolling steps. Larger values scroll more slowly.
display.text_scrolling.speed_ms.label: Speed ms

display.text_scrolling.end_delay_ms.label: End delay ms

display.phone.scroll_wheel_phone_menu.label: Automatic Phone Wheel Control
display.phone.scroll_wheel_phone_menu.help: Automatically enter DIS wheel control for the visible center phone page or top-only phone display. Double-click MODE to return to normal wheel mappings for the current call. Manual readings control takes priority. Page showing is configured separately.

display.phone.claim_on_phone.help: Auto-claim center display on incoming/active phone calls and release when ended.
display.phone.claim_on_phone.label: Claim on phone

interfaces.can.diagnostic.detailedHelp: This is the interface diagnostic functions are done on. It does not necessarily have to be the OBD2 port CANbus. It should work over infotainment on most gateways as far as im aware.
interfaces.can.diagnostic.label: Diagnostic

interfaces.zmq.dis_display_status.label: DIS Display Status ZMQ
interfaces.zmq.dis_display_status.help: ZeroMQ publication address for center-DIS presentation and app state, used to coordinate wheel ownership and top-line content.

interfaces.zmq.can_raw_stream.label: CAN Raw Stream ZMQ
interfaces.zmq.can_raw_stream.help: ZeroMQ publication address for received SocketCAN frames, consumed by keyboard, vehicle-state and diagnostic services.

interfaces.zmq.send_address.label: CAN Send Address ZMQ
interfaces.zmq.send_address.help: ZeroMQ command address for outgoing CAN frames. CAN consumers send requests here; the CAN service writes them onto the bus.

interfaces.zmq.system_events.label: System Events ZMQ
interfaces.zmq.system_events.help: ZeroMQ publication address for shared vehicle power events such as ignition, radio state and door wake transitions.

interfaces.zmq.dis_draw.label: DIS Draw ZMQ
interfaces.zmq.dis_draw.help: ZeroMQ address for DIS drawing commands sent by display apps to the cluster drawing service.

interfaces.zmq.dis_status.label: DIS Status ZMQ
interfaces.zmq.dis_status.help: ZeroMQ address for the cluster drawing service’s session/status events, used by the display coordinator.

interfaces.zmq.tp2_stream.label: TP2 Stream ZMQ
interfaces.zmq.tp2_stream.help: ZeroMQ publication address for TP2 diagnostic session responses and measuring-group data.

interfaces.zmq.tp2_command.label: TP2 Command ZMQ
interfaces.zmq.tp2_command.help: ZeroMQ command address for diagnostic-worker requests such as opening a session and reading a measuring group.

interfaces.zmq.metric_stream.label: Metric Stream ZMQ
interfaces.zmq.metric_stream.help: ZeroMQ publication address for Hudiy API data including media, phone and navigation state. DIS and DataView consume these updates.

features.log_saver.services.label: Log Saver Services
features.log_saver.services.help: List of systemd services to save logs for.

features.log_saver.minutes.label: Log Duration (Minutes)
features.log_saver.minutes.help: How far back to save logs in minutes.

features.log_saver.log_directory.label: Log Directory
features.log_saver.log_directory.help: Path where logs will be saved. Supports relative ~/ paths.

file_portal.upload_pin.label: Upload PIN
file_portal.upload_pin.help: Optional PIN required when uploading firmware from a phone. Leave empty to allow uploads from any device on the Pi network.

file_portal.archive_limit_mb.label: Maximum Bundle Size (MB)
file_portal.archive_limit_mb.help: Maximum uncompressed size allowed by Download All.

file_portal.runtime_log_directory.label: Live Service Log Directory
file_portal.runtime_log_directory.help: Directory containing current file-based service logs.

file_portal.firmware_targets.label: Firmware Targets
file_portal.firmware_targets.help: JSON list of firmware upload targets. Each object defines id, label, description, directory, extensions, validator and max_size_mb. Supported validators: haldex and pq-eps. Extensions are a list such as [".bin"]. Keep each target’s directory aligned with its controller firmware_dir.

ddp_bitmap_message_bytes.help: Maximum bytes in each DDP bitmap message (13–195). Larger messages reduce command overhead. Multi-row commands require 105 or fewer bytes. Default example: 105.

diagnostics.enabled.help: Enable the diagnostic worker used to read ECU measuring groups. CAN-derived readings can still be available independently.
diagnostics.enabled.label: Enabled

diagnostics.values.diagnostic_hz.help: Default requested frequency, in Hz, for diagnostic values without an explicit polling period. Actual delivery depends on ECU and bus capacity.
diagnostics.values.diagnostic_hz.label: Diagnostic hz

diagnostics.values.ican_hz.help: Default requested frequency, in Hz, for infotainment CAN values without an explicit polling period.
diagnostics.values.ican_hz.label: Ican hz

diagnostics.values.lease_seconds.help: Seconds before the shared value broker expires a client’s requests when the client stops renewing its interest.
diagnostics.values.lease_seconds.label: Lease seconds

haldex.enabled.help: Enable the Haldex control manager. Mode changes require compatible controller firmware; this setting does not flash firmware.
haldex.enabled.label: Enabled

haldex.default_mode.help: Startup mode: null restores the last saved mode, 0 = Stock, 1 = Performance, 2 = Competition. A fixed mode disables saving mode changes as the next startup choice.
haldex.default_mode.label: Default mode

haldex.burst_count.help: Number of CAN frames sent in a Haldex mode command burst. Repeated frames help the controller receive the requested mode.
haldex.burst_count.label: Burst count

haldex.burst_interval_ms.help: Pause in milliseconds between frames in each Haldex mode command burst.
haldex.burst_interval_ms.label: Burst interval ms

haldex.persistence_file.help: JSON file storing the last requested Haldex mode when default_mode is null. The Pi service must be able to write here.
haldex.persistence_file.label: Persistence file

haldex.firmware_dir.help: Directory containing Haldex firmware available in DataView and the file portal. A leading ~ expands to the Pi service user’s home directory.
haldex.firmware_dir.label: Firmware dir

eps.firmware_dir.help: Directory containing steering controller images or datasets for the EPS tools. A leading ~ expands on the Pi.
eps.firmware_dir.label: Firmware dir

exhaust_valve.firmware_dir.help: Directory used for exhaust-valve firmware images. The flashing tools inspect candidate firmware before deployment.
exhaust_valve.firmware_dir.label: Firmware dir

exhaust_valve.installed_generation_floor.help: Minimum deployed exhaust-control firmware generation assumed when no deployment record exists. Keep this aligned with the firmware actually installed.
exhaust_valve.installed_generation_floor.label: Installed generation floor

exhaust_valve.generation_file.help: Deployment record used to track installed exhaust-control firmware generation and determine supported commands.
exhaust_valve.generation_file.label: Generation file

exhaust_valve.intent_file.help: JSON persistence file for the requested exhaust-valve behavior, restored by the Haldex manager.
exhaust_valve.intent_file.label: Intent file

data_logger.default_profile.label: Default profile

data_logger.log_directory.help: Directory for raw/debug sessions, separate from named-value recordings under data_logs.directory. Supports ~ on the Pi.
data_logger.log_directory.label: Log directory

data_logger.queue_size.help: Maximum queued raw/debug records before the writer falls behind. Runtime enforces at least 100; dropped records are reported.
data_logger.queue_size.label: Queue size

data_logger.profiles.haldex.measuring_gr.help: Additional diagnostic groups for raw Haldex sessions. JSON list of objects: module (hex address), groups (list of group numbers), low_priority_groups (optional list), value_count (default 4). An empty list uses the built-in profile groups.
data_logger.profiles.haldex.measuring_gr.label: Measuring groups

openpilot.enabled.help: Reserved setting. Openpilot integration is disabled in the current runtime because its CAN identifiers conflict with Haldex control; enabling this setting does not activate it.
openpilot.enabled.label: Enabled

display.center_display.start_inactive.help: Start with the original cluster presentation until HUDiy display ownership is requested. Useful when you want the factory screen visible at boot.
display.center_display.start_inactive.label: Start inactive

display.text_centering.help: Center short text in the DIS text area. Long text uses the scrolling settings instead.
display.text_centering.label: Text centering

features.sync_android_auto.help: When day/night synchronization runs, explicitly set Android Auto’s appearance mode as well as Hudiy’s common/system mode. Disabled uses the common mode alone; this does not connect or disconnect Android Auto.
features.sync_android_auto.label: Sync android auto

features.mmi_controls.help: Translate RNS-E buttons and knob events into the configured keyboard mappings.
features.mmi_controls.label: Mmi controls

features.mfsw_controls.help: Translate multifunction steering-wheel events into keyboard actions. DIS wheel ownership uses these events for phone and readings controls.
features.mfsw_controls.label: Mfsw controls

features.system_actions.help: Allow MMI extended-press mappings to run system commands such as saving logs, rebooting or shutting down.
features.system_actions.label: System actions

features.time_sync.enabled.help: Set the Pi clock from the vehicle’s CAN time message when its drift exceeds the configured threshold.
features.time_sync.enabled.label: Enabled

features.time_sync.data_format.help: Vehicle time-message encoding. old_logic decodes BCD time/date fields; new_logic decodes binary fields. Match your vehicle’s transmitted format.
features.time_sync.data_format.label: Data format

features.power_management.auto_shutdown..help: Enable automatic Pi shutdown after the selected power-state trigger persists for the delay.
features.power_management.auto_shutdown..label: Enabled

features.power_management.auto_shutdown..help: Power-state transition that starts the shutdown timer: ignition_off or key_pulled. A return to the active state cancels the timer; an active GPIO wake signal holds off shutdown.
features.power_management.auto_shutdown..label: Trigger

features.power_management.listen_only_mo.help: Place the infotainment SocketCAN interface into listen-only mode after the vehicle bus is ready to sleep, avoiding transmissions that keep it awake.
features.power_management.listen_only_mo.label: Enabled

features.power_management.listen_only_mo.help: Seconds to wait after the sleep-ready condition before switching the CAN interface to listen-only.
features.power_management.listen_only_mo.label: Delay seconds

features.power_management.listen_only_mo.help: Seconds since ignition turned OFF before forcing the sleep-ready state, even if network-management frames still arrive. This is a fallback for vehicles that keep transmitting.
features.power_management.listen_only_mo.label: Fallback seconds

features.power_management.gpio_shutdown..help: Watch the configured GPIO and shut down the Pi when its shutdown level persists for the delay.
features.power_management.gpio_shutdown..label: Enabled

features.power_management.gpio_shutdown..help: BCM GPIO number of the shutdown input. This is a GPIO number, not a physical header-pin number.
features.power_management.gpio_shutdown..label: Pin

features.power_management.gpio_shutdown..help: Seconds the GPIO must remain at its shutdown level before the Pi shuts down.
features.power_management.gpio_shutdown..label: Delay seconds

features.power_management.connection_man.help: Automatically manage Hudiy Android Auto and Bluetooth connections using ignition, radio and wake events.
features.power_management.connection_man.label: Enabled

features.tv_simulation.enabled.help: Transmit TV tuner presence frames so the RNS-E can select the TV source used by the video interface.
features.tv_simulation.enabled.label: Enabled

input_mappings.mmi.scroll_commands.help: MMI byte pairs treated as immediate rotary events. These bypass press-duration handling; the matching short-press mapping chooses the keyboard key.
input_mappings.mmi.scroll_commands.label: Scroll commands

input_mappings.mfsw.commands.release.help: Two-byte steering-wheel release pattern. Keep this as a JSON array of hex strings, matching the vehicle CAN payload.
input_mappings.mfsw.commands.release.label: Release

input_mappings.source.tv_mode_identifier.help: Hex source-state byte identifying TV mode. Source controls pause playback when leaving TV and resume when returning.
input_mappings.source.tv_mode_identifier.label: Tv mode identifier

input_mappings.source.play_key.help: Keyboard key emitted on returning to the TV source when features.source_controls is enabled.
input_mappings.source.play_key.label: Play key

input_mappings.source.pause_key.help: Keyboard key emitted on leaving the TV source when features.source_controls is enabled.
input_mappings.source.pause_key.label: Pause key

interfaces.zmq.haldex_command.help: Local ZeroMQ endpoint accepting Haldex and exhaust-control requests from DataView.
interfaces.zmq.haldex_command.label: Haldex command

interfaces.zmq.haldex_status.help: Local ZeroMQ endpoint publishing requested and observed Haldex state to DataView and other consumers.
interfaces.zmq.haldex_status.label: Haldex status

can_ids.light_status.help: Vehicle light state used for Hudiy day/night mode. Enter a hexadecimal CAN identifier, for example 0x635.
can_ids.light_status.label: Light status

can_ids.time_data.help: Vehicle clock and date used for Pi clock synchronization. Enter a hexadecimal CAN identifier, for example 0x635.
can_ids.time_data.label: Time data

can_ids.ignition_status.help: Ignition and key state used by power and connection management. Enter a hexadecimal CAN identifier, for example 0x635.
can_ids.ignition_status.label: Ignition status

can_ids.door_status.help: Door state used for connection wake windows. Enter a hexadecimal CAN identifier, for example 0x635.
can_ids.door_status.label: Door status

can_ids.gateway_nm_status.help: Gateway network-management state used to detect bus sleep. Enter a hexadecimal CAN identifier, for example 0x635.
can_ids.gateway_nm_status.label: Gateway nm status

can_ids.nav_nm_status.help: RNS-E network-management state used to track radio activity. Enter a hexadecimal CAN identifier, for example 0x635.
can_ids.nav_nm_status.label: Nav nm status

can_ids.tv_presence.help: TV tuner presence frames transmitted by TV simulation. Enter a hexadecimal CAN identifier, for example 0x635.
can_ids.tv_presence.label: Tv presence

can_ids.fis_line1.help: First factory top-DIS text line. Enter a hexadecimal CAN identifier, for example 0x635.
can_ids.fis_line1.label: Fis line1

can_ids.fis_line2.help: Second factory top-DIS text line. Enter a hexadecimal CAN identifier, for example 0x635.
can_ids.fis_line2.label: Fis line2

can_ids.media_status.help: Factory media source status. Enter a hexadecimal CAN identifier, for example 0x635.
can_ids.media_status.label: Media status

can_ids.nav_status.help: Factory navigation status. Enter a hexadecimal CAN identifier, for example 0x635.
can_ids.nav_status.label: Nav status

can_ids.mmi.help: RNS-E button and rotary input frames. Enter a hexadecimal CAN identifier, for example 0x635.
can_ids.mmi.label: Mmi

can_ids.mfsw.help: Multifunction steering-wheel input frames. Enter a hexadecimal CAN identifier, for example 0x635.
can_ids.mfsw.label: Mfsw

can_ids.source.help: Selected RNS-E source state. Enter a hexadecimal CAN identifier, for example 0x635.
can_ids.source.label: Source

display.center_display.coverart.args.dit.help: Monochrome dither method, e.g. fs for Floyd–Steinberg.

display.center_display.coverart.args.bg_.help: Background color used when fitting the image.

display.center_display.coverart.args.gra.help: Grayscale conversion strategy; smart uses luminance processing.

display.center_display.coverart.args.bla.help: Shadow cutoff (0–255) used before monochrome conversion.

display.center_display.coverart.args.bol.help: Pixel expansion amount for strengthening fine features.

rnse.auto_brightness.enabled.label: Automatic RNS-E brightness
rnse.auto_brightness.enabled.help: Set RNS-E screen brightness from vehicle day/night state. Sends a brightness command when the light state changes or the radio wakes. This is separate from Hudiy and Android Auto theme switching.

rnse.auto_brightness.day_brightness.label: Day brightness
rnse.auto_brightness.day_brightness.help: RNS-E screen brightness in daytime: 0 is the lowest level and 10 is the highest. Used only when automatic RNS-E brightness is enabled.

rnse.auto_brightness.night_brightness.label: Night brightness
rnse.auto_brightness.night_brightness.help: RNS-E screen brightness when the vehicle reports night mode: 0 is the lowest level and 10 is the highest. Used only when automatic RNS-E brightness is enabled.

rnse.manual_brightness.label: Manual screen brightness
rnse.manual_brightness.help: Startup baseline for RNS-E screen brightness when automatic screen brightness is off. The day/night brightness sliders are for live testing; releasing a slider sends one frame without changing this startup value.

rnse.auto_lcd_brightness.enabled.label: Automatic LCD brightness
rnse.auto_lcd_brightness.enabled.help: Set the separate RNS-E LCD panel brightness from vehicle day/night state. The LCD level uses its own scale and is independent of screen brightness.

rnse.auto_lcd_brightness.day_brightness.label: Day LCD brightness
rnse.auto_lcd_brightness.day_brightness.help: LCD level for daytime, from 0 to 100. This controls the RNS-E LCD panel, not the overall screen brightness.

rnse.auto_lcd_brightness.night_brightnes.label: Night LCD brightness
rnse.auto_lcd_brightness.night_brightnes.help: LCD level for night mode, from 0 to 100. This controls the RNS-E LCD panel, not the overall screen brightness.

rnse.manual_lcd_brightness.label: Manual LCD brightness
rnse.manual_lcd_brightness.help: Startup baseline for the LCD panel when automatic LCD brightness is off. Day/night LCD sliders are for live testing; releasing a slider sends one frame without changing this startup value.

rnse.source_label.enabled.label: Show source label
rnse.source_label.enabled.help: Opt in to showing a label based on Hudiy’s reported media or navigation provider. This reports the provider Hudiy sees, not whether that source is currently connected.

input_mappings.mmi.long_press.0,32.help: Action for RNS-E long press (0,32). Enter a Linux KEY_* name, e.g. KEY_ENTER. null disables the action.

input_mappings.mmi.long_press.0,64.help: Action for RNS-E long press (0,64). Enter a Linux KEY_* name, e.g. KEY_ENTER. null disables the action.

input_mappings.mmi.extended_press.0,32.help: Action for RNS-E extended press (0,32). Enter a shell command run on the Pi; features.system_actions must be enabled.

input_mappings.mmi.extended_press.0,64.help: Action for RNS-E extended press (0,64). Enter a shell command run on the Pi; features.system_actions must be enabled.
